resources.string: Mac
Mac windows and the Mac desktop on the external screen, through Sill on the Mac
Add Mac
Needs Sill 0.6.1 or later on the Mac. Over Tailscale use the Mac\'s 100.x address
Address
The Mac\'s address, and its port if Sill\'s Remote Access port is not 7455
Next
Pairing code
On the Mac choose Sill › Pair iPhone or iPad…, then type the 12 digits it shows
Pair
That is not an address. Write it as 100.64.0.1 or mac.local:7455
The code has 12 digits; check for a typo
Pairing with the Mac…
Paired with %1$s
Wrong code. Check the digits on the Mac and try again
The Mac is not showing a pairing code. Choose Pair iPhone or iPad… in Sill on the Mac first
The Mac is busy with another pairing. Try again in a moment
Pairing failed: %1$s
Fit to screen
Resize the Mac window to this screen. Sill puts it back when the stream ends
Mac keyboard
Off: a PC keyboard, Ctrl works as ⌘, Win as Ctrl, Alt as ⌥
Remove %1$s
To connect again you pair again. Remove XDesk in Sill\'s Devices on the Mac too
Remove
